summary: Full backend + frontend test of the Deep Immersion arc. Created /app/backend/tests/test_deep_immersion.py (26 live-API pytest cases): prayer catalogue, prayer submit (live gpt-4o), per-god cooldown, validation, blessings/history/recent, Tongue of Y'ros state/attempt/cooldown/history/relinquish, admin image-batch survey+status (read-only, no generation triggered), idempotent seed endpoints, and canon greps. 26/26 pass. Existing tests/test_prayer_service.py 12/12 pass. Frontend: Playwright e2e on the preview URL covered login, navbar (nav-prayers + '215 A.E.'), /prayers (4 god cards, char picker, race-affinity badge, ring highlight, submit gating, live prayer submission -> result modal 'A Flicker' with narration + boon, close, recent prayers list), /tongue-of-yros (state banner, picker, non-dwarf warning, textarea, disabled submit, history), and the admin Database tab (both new seed panels clicked and returned correct idempotent results; image-batch panel present but Generate was NOT clicked).

minor.issue: Prayer text shorter than 10 chars returns 422 (Pydantic min_length on PrayerSubmitPayload), not the 409 stated in the test request. Service-level ValueError path is unreachable. Cosmetic/spec mismatch only — UI already blocks <10 chars.
attempt_text min_length is 15 at the route and 15 in the service (request doc said 20+). Consistent internally; just note the doc drift.

issues: /tongue-of-yros has a route but no navbar/dashboard link anywhere — the page is only reachable by typing the URL. Consider a nav entry or a link from the Prayers page / Thal'Karrak city page.

Admin account shows 4 identically named 'Focused Test Hero — Human (Warrior)' options (leftover test data). Not a code bug, but the picker gives no way to tell them apart; consider appending a short id/nation suffix.

action_items: Optional: add a navbar/dashboard entry point for /tongue-of-yros (currently URL-only).
Optional: align prayer-length rejection status (422 vs 409) with the documented contract.
critical_code_review_comments: DatabaseSeedPanel.js is 792 lines — over the 700-line guideline; split the image-batch and per-tier seed cards into separate components.

prayer_service.py sets expires_at for 'flicker' verdicts as well as 'blessing' and get_active_blessings() surfaces both; intentional per docstring but means a flicker occupies the god's 'active blessing' slot for 6h — verify that's desired.
PrayerService._existing_blessing_active only downgrades blessings from the SAME god, so a character can hold four simultaneous blessings (one per god). Confirm this is the intended power ceiling.
Ehena has an empty race_affinity list so affinity_match is always false for her — the UI correctly shows no badge, but affinity_bias is 0 (neither nudge). Fine, just flagging the asymmetry.
Image-batch status panel is conditionally rendered (only after iterations_run/generated > 0 or is_running) — verified as intended, not a missing test-id.
seed_data_creation: Cleared prior prayers for character 'Admin Buyer' (Elf) and tongue attempts for 'Ausar Veltraus' to exercise cooldowns; created 3 real prayers (seren, yros, ehena) and 1 tongue attempt via live API. Ran both idempotent seed endpoints (dhor-kuldor canon 6 refreshed, titan sites 14 already annotated).

Each full run makes 3 live gpt-4o calls (~cents). Image batch generation was never triggered (865 images still missing, ~$34 if run). Tongue of Y'ros bearer_active is still false; no dwarf character exists on the admin account, so the 'drawn'/'tremor' path is untested.
rca_of_the_issue: No defects found; the only deviations are documentation/spec drift on HTTP status for short prayers and a missing navigation entry point for the Tongue of Y'ros page.
